title: nan
authors: Mugnai M.; Teppati Losé M.; Herrera-Alarcón E.P.; Baris G.; Satler M.; Avizzano C.A.
key_contribution: Presents an integrated ROS/PX4 autonomy framework for UAV perception, visual localization, and obstacle avoidance in GNSS-denied environments validated in simulation and the Leonardo Drone Contest.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
